notes: INSIDE half of the Pulse Mk1: the revolving six-chamber drum IS the charge indicator: charge frame i loads (0,2,3,4,5,6) chambers and indexes the drum half a step on odd frames; frame 5 = ready (all lit, centre pixel white). Plus power coupling, repair hatch and an amber strip. fire: the drum is spent (empty chambers). damaged: drum rim cracked, a bent casing jams a chamber; disabled: drum split, casings spilled. Barrel layer pulse_mk1_barrel: stubby plasma barrel. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
